text: Turn on a random green led on acting as a mole showing up a hole. The player will press the button on the same led to hit the mole. If the player takes too long or anther button is pressed, flash all led with red indicating that it was wrong. If a mole was hit, move the mole to another hole (turn on another green led, in a random place, it's okay it it is the same one). after 5 moles have been correctly hit, make the timeout to hit the mole shorter. If 3 moles are not wacked, it's game over and flash all leds red until a button is presst to start the game again.

Nice idea! Now a green mole pops up in one hole, you smack it fast. Miss it or hit the wrong hole and the board flashes red. Get 3 wrong and it's game over — tap any light to play again. After 5 good hits, the mole gets quicker!
sometimes add two moles. make it slower at the begining and quickly build up speed
Ooh, double moles sounds fun! I'll make moles sometimes pop up in pairs, and the mole timer will start nice and slow, then get faster and faster the more you hit.
something happened that it is flashing red right away. fix it.

Found it — the mole timer was accidentally being squeezed into a tiny number, so the "too slow" timeout was only about 0.15 seconds instead of 2+ seconds. That's why it flashed red almost instantly. Fixed it!The mole's timer was being squeezed into a number box too small to hold it, so it thought time was almost up right away. I made the box bigger. Now the timer works properly!
